_comment: Checks known to fail, and why. CI reports them but does not fail on them. A check NOT listed here that fails is a regression and fails the build. Remove an id from this list the moment it is fixed.
_seeded: Seeded 2026-09-21 from the first real run with the eight leaks the review documented at v6.7.0. Phase 1 of docs/STEALTH_REVIEW_2026-09.md closed seven of them on 2026-09-21 and they were deleted from this list in the same commit: navigator-webdriver, useragentdata-brands, headless-markers, worker-platform, worker-hardware-concurrency, worker-languages, ua-version-vs-binary. Re-measured after the fixes on macOS arm64 (Chromium 151.0.7922.34 + Camoufox 135.0.1-beta.24, Playwright 1.62.1, residential AS7922): 19 pass, 0 fail, 1 skip — the skip is useragentdata-brands on camoufox, which Firefox does not expose.

_findings.persona-os-vs-host: camoufox only, and it is upstream's. Chromium passes deterministically since Phase 1 (the persona OS is the host's). camoufox npm 0.1.19 accepts the documented `os` option, validates it, and then drops it: it forwards `{ screen, os }` to fingerprint-generator, whose option is `operatingSystems: string[]`, so the OS is drawn from market share instead — measured 2026-09-21 as a Mac persona about one launch in three on a Mac host, with and without `locale`. We still pass `os` (inert, and correct the moment upstream honours it). Owned by Phase 2 of the stealth review, which takes the camoufox client. Listed because it fails on roughly two draws in three.
